draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.93, the 172nd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 16th of 20 at DE. He went 82nd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (172nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (94th percentile), 10-yard split (92nd percentile), vertical jump (84th percentile). College production: his final season (2022) ranked 3rd in sacks among the 19 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. 51 career games and 41 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 7 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 13 (94th percentile), season snap share 75.0% (91st percentile), pressures 32 (89th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 edge rusher who played: 7.0 sacks against a median of 2.0, above the norm.
